From level %level% you may meet a Thief, marked [Thief: 0%].

A Thief steals from every monster killed near it, and its bag fills up: watch the number grow in its title. When you kill the Thief, it drops its adena many times over - the fuller the bag, the bigger the prize.

Tip: let it watch you hunt for a while, then strike. But don't wait too long - at night a Thief with a full bag runs off into the dark.
